header.title: Automation
header.subtitle: Configure how your machine produces videos

toast.paused: Automation paused. The current video will be completed.
toast.started: Automation started! Videos will be produced continuously.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which gameplay to use as source
content.gameHint: Choose a specific game or let the system pick randomly
content.reuse1: 1 time (each clip appears in only 1 video)
content.reuseHint: Maximum number of videos in which the same gameplay region can appear. History is always recorded for diversity analysis.
content.fallbackHint: When your gameplays run out, use public gameplays from other users?

format.title: Format
format.durationHint: E.g.: 10 = 10s scenes · 7200 = one long continuous scene

voice.title: Voice
voice.hint: Upload a short audio (5-30s) of the voice for XTTS to clone.

style.title: Style
style.hint: The style influences the tone and humor of the AI-generated script

queue.title: Production Queue
queue.description: How automation chooses the next video
queue.kidsDescription: How automation chooses the next Kids video
queue.manualDesc: Manual: automation only produces videos from ideas you queue. When the queue empties, production stops until you add more.
queue.automaticDesc: Automatic: when the queue empties, the system automatically decides the next video based on available material.
queue.maxSizeHint: How many fresh ideas to add automatically (sorted by editorial score).
queue.kidsAutoDesc: Automatic: the system fills the queue with the best automatically evaluated ideas.
queue.kidsManualDesc: Manual: you add ideas to the queue manually. When the queue empties, production stops.
queue.kidsAutoFill: Automatically fill queue with the best evaluated ideas
queue.kidsMaxSizeHint: How many evaluated ideas to add automatically (sorted by score).

domain.title: Channel Domain
domain.description: Type of content this channel produces. Switching is destructive.
domain.warning: Switching domains erases all channel production state (media, jobs, unpublished content, knowledge). Videos already published on YouTube are not removed.
domain.willBeRemoved: The following data will be permanently removed:
domain.preservedNote: Videos already published on YouTube will not be removed. The YouTube connection will not be changed.
domain.confirmContinue: I understand and want to continue
